figures.finding: Vatican City has no producers' agreement, guild or film fund: the Holy See's labour office covers the staff of the Curia, the State and Vatican Radio, and expressly leaves out one-off work and service contracts, so an engagement on a production there is set by its own contract.

value.labourBody: Ufficio del Lavoro della Sede Apostolica (ULSA)

figures.applies: Vatican City State (VA), as of the statute published on vatican.va; a December 2025 revision of the ULSA statute was reported but not read.

sources.said: L'attività dell'Ufficio si riferisce al lavoro, in tutte le sue forme ed applicazioni, prestato dal personale dipendente della Curia Romana, dello Stato della Città del Vaticano, della Radio Vaticana … Dalla competenza del medesimo Ufficio sono esclusi rapporti di lavoro, pur esistenti con gli stessi Organismi o Enti ma derivanti da altri singolari contratti di lavoro o di prestazione d'opera.

figures.finding: The Holy See makes its own documentaries: in June 2025 the Editorial Directorate of the Dicastery for Communication released 'León de Perú', on Pope Leo XIV's years in Peru, premiered on the Vatican News YouTube channel in Spanish, Italian and English.

value.producer: Dicastery for Communication (Vatican Media), Editorial Directorate

figures.applies: Vatican City / Holy See; in-house documentary production (no fiction production or outside-producer fund found).

sources.said: The documentary is a production of the Editorial Directorate of the Dicastery for Communication and was created by journalists Salvatore Cernuzio, Felipe Herrera-Espaliat, and Jaime Vizcaíno Haro. At 5:00 PM (Rome time), the film will premiere on the Vatican News YouTube channel in Spanish, Italian, and English
